character_consistency.note_ja: Keep character appearance consistent primarily by writing the same appearance prompt in each request. LoRA effectiveness is unverified; test it in character trials before using it across panels. Convert prompts to variables only when requested by the user. Reference images (IP-Adapter), i2i, and ControlNet are undocumented in current official API docs; test on a single panel after user approval before expanding.

batch_size.cost_note_ja: On Tsubaki.3 pro 1k, 1 image costs 4,000 credits and 4 images cost 7,000 credits (verified in the user's PixAI usage history, 2026-10-25). Default to choosing from 4 candidates for complex panels and reworks.

panel_aspect_note_ja: v2 determines dimensions from aspectRatio and size (1k or 1.5k). Choose an aspect ratio close to the panel shape, generate a slightly wider area than the panel bounds, and reveal the intended region with panel frames and masks during composition.

credits.note_ja: No balance or credit-consumption query endpoint is documented in the official API. Pass --confirm-credits only when the user has explicitly authorized credit consumption for that scope.

implementation_note_ja: Operational settings. Read during production startup and confirm cost authorization with the user before sending.
